product_overview: SEC is the platform’s central security backend for authentication, user administration, hierarchical role-based access control, auditing, session management, and module registry onboarding. It also exposes read-only cross-module security data for consuming services and provides optional notification hooks for password resets.
core_goals: Provide secure login, sign-up, and password reset flows for platform users
Enable administrators to manage users, roles, permissions, and active sessions
Support hierarchical module → screen → action permission grants with hierarchy enforcement
Maintain an immutable, searchable, exportable audit trail of security-relevant events
Allow consuming modules to register themselves and derive effective menus from granted permissions
Expose safe read-only cross-module lookups for user contact details and permission holders
Support optional password-reset notifications without making notifications a hard dependency

features.name: SEC Authentication
features.description: Allows public users to log in, submit sign-up requests, and request/complete password resets using stateless JWT-based security.
user_flows: POST /api/v1/sec/auth/login with valid credentials -> Receive 200 with accessToken, tokenType, and expiresIn -> Use Authorization: Bearer <accessToken> for protected SEC endpoints -> Receive 200 from a protected endpoint
POST /api/v1/sec/auth/login with invalid credentials -> Receive 401 SEC-401-INVALID-CREDENTIALS -> No token issued and login attempt recorded as failed
POST /api/v1/sec/auth/signup with a new email and profile names -> Receive 200 with SignupRequest statusCode=PENDING -> No User is created yet
POST /api/v1/sec/auth/signup with an email already registered or already pending -> Receive 409 SEC-409-SIGNUP-DUP -> No new signup request is created
POST /api/v1/sec/auth/password-reset/request with a registered email -> Receive 200 generic confirmation -> PasswordResetToken is created without revealing whether the email exists
POST /api/v1/sec/auth/password-reset/complete with a valid token and new password -> Receive 200 confirmation -> User password is updated and token is marked used
POST /api/v1/sec/auth/password-reset/complete with an expired or already used token -> Receive 409 SEC-409-RESET-TOKEN-INVALID -> Password remains unchanged

features.name: SEC Users
features.description: Supports direct user provisioning, user search, user updates, role assignment, and lifecycle changes such as deactivation and reactivation.
user_flows: POST /api/v1/sec/users with unique username, email, names, and password -> Receive 200 with UserResponse -> User is created with statusCode=ACTIVE by default
POST /api/v1/sec/users/search with paging and filters -> Receive 200 with a paginated list of matching users -> Results can be filtered by username, email, full name, and status
PUT /api/v1/sec/users/{id} with updated profile data -> Receive 200 with updated UserResponse -> User record is changed
PUT /api/v1/sec/users/{id}/roles with roleIds for non-conflicting active roles -> Receive 200 with UserResponse -> Role assignment rows are replaced with the selected roles
PUT /api/v1/sec/users/{id}/roles with roleIds that would create a separation-of-duties conflict -> Receive 409 SEC-409-SOD-CONFLICT -> Conflicting assignment is rejected
DELETE /api/v1/sec/users/{id} for an active user -> Receive 200 with statusCode=DISABLED -> Active sessions for that user are terminated
PATCH /api/v1/sec/users/{id} for a disabled user -> Receive 200 with statusCode=ACTIVE -> User can sign in again with valid credentials
PUT /api/v1/sec/users/{id} for a missing user id -> Receive 404 SEC-404-USER -> No update is applied

features.name: SEC Sign-up Requests
features.description: Lets administrators approve or reject pending sign-up requests, converting approved requests into active users.
user_flows: PATCH /api/v1/sec/signup-requests/{id} with decision=APPROVE for a PENDING request -> Receive 200 with UserResponse -> SignupRequest becomes APPROVED and a User is created with statusCode=ACTIVE
PATCH /api/v1/sec/signup-requests/{id} with decision=REJECT for a PENDING request -> Receive 200 with SignupRequestResponse -> SignupRequest becomes REJECTED and no User is created
PATCH /api/v1/sec/signup-requests/{id} for a request that is not PENDING -> Receive 409 SEC-409-INVALID-TRANSITION -> Request state does not change
PATCH /api/v1/sec/signup-requests/{id} for a missing request id -> Receive 404 SEC-404-SIGNUP -> No decision is recorded

features.name: SEC Roles
features.description: Provides creation and search of roles that later receive module, screen, and action grants.
user_flows: POST /api/v1/sec/roles with a new role code and bilingual name -> Receive 200 with RoleResponse -> Role is created
POST /api/v1/sec/roles/search with paging and filters -> Receive 200 with a paginated list of roles -> Matching roles are returned
POST /api/v1/sec/roles with a duplicate role code -> Receive 409 SEC-409-ROLE-DUP -> No duplicate role is created

features.name: SEC Role Grants
features.description: Manages hierarchical permission grants for roles across modules, screens, and actions with cascade revoke and VIEW gating enforcement.
user_flows: POST /api/v1/sec/roles/{id}/modules with a registered moduleId -> Receive 200 with RoleModuleGrantResponse -> Module grant is created for the role
POST /api/v1/sec/roles/{id}/screens with a screenId after the role already holds the module grant -> Receive 200 with RoleScreenGrantResponse -> Screen grant is created
POST /api/v1/sec/roles/{id}/screens without the parent module grant -> Receive 409 SEC-409-NO-MODULE-GRANT -> No RoleScreenGrant row is created
POST /api/v1/sec/roles/{id}/actions with an actionId after the role already holds the screen grant and VIEW on that screen -> Receive 200 with RoleActionGrantResponse -> Action grant is created
POST /api/v1/sec/roles/{id}/actions without the parent screen grant -> Receive 409 SEC-409-NO-SCREEN-GRANT -> No RoleActionGrant row is created
POST /api/v1/sec/roles/{id}/actions for a non-VIEW action when VIEW is not yet granted on the same screen -> Receive 409 SEC-409-NO-VIEW-GRANT -> The action is rejected

DELETE /api/v1/sec/roles/{id}/modules/{moduleId} for an existing module grant -> Receive 200 with revokedScreenGrants and revokedActionGrants counts -> All dependent screen and action grants under that module are removed
POST /api/v1/sec/roles/{id}/actions for a permission pair declared conflicting by the owning module -> Receive 409 SEC-409-SOD-CONFLICT -> Conflicting action grant is rejected

features.name: SEC Module Registry
features.description: Registers modules, screens, and actions as data so consuming modules can onboard permissions without changing security code.
user_flows: POST /api/v1/sec/registry/modules with a new module code and bilingual name -> Receive 200 with ModuleRegistryResponse -> Module is registered as active
POST /api/v1/sec/registry/screens with a registered moduleCode and new pageCode -> Receive 200 with ScreenRegistryResponse -> Screen is registered under that module
POST /api/v1/sec/registry/screens with an unregistered moduleCode -> Receive 409 SEC-409-MODULE-NOT-REGISTERED -> Screen is not created
POST /api/v1/sec/registry/actions with a registered pageCode and new actionCode -> Receive 200 with ActionRegistryResponse -> Permission code is derived as PERM_<pageCode>_<actionCode>
POST /api/v1/sec/registry/actions with an unregistered pageCode -> Receive 409 SEC-409-SCREEN-NOT-REGISTERED -> Action is not created
POST /api/v1/sec/registry/search with filters and paging -> Receive 200 with a paginated registry view -> Module, screen, and action rows are returned

features.name: SEC Menu
features.description: Returns the caller’s effective two-level navigation tree based only on grants they actually hold.
user_flows: GET /api/v1/sec/menu with a bearer token for a user holding granted modules and screens -> Receive 200 with a list of ModuleMenuResponse -> Only effective modules and screens appear
GET /api/v1/sec/menu for a user with no grant on a module -> Receive 200 with that module omitted -> Ungranted modules never appear
GET /api/v1/sec/menu after granting or revoking permissions on the user’s roles -> Receive 200 with an updated menu tree -> Response reflects the current effective grants
GET /api/v1/sec/menu without a bearer token -> Receive 401 or authorization failure from the security layer -> Menu is not returned

features.name: SEC Security Dashboard
features.description: Provides a live administrative dashboard with security widgets computed from current data and selectively omitted based on permission.
user_flows: GET /api/v1/sec/dashboard with an authorized admin token -> Receive 200 with live dashboard summary -> Widgets such as recent activity and onboarding funnel are computed from current data
GET /api/v1/sec/dashboard twice with a new login occurring between requests -> Receive 200 both times -> Second response reflects the new event without stale cached values
GET /api/v1/sec/dashboard for a role lacking the active sessions widget permission -> Receive 200 with that widget omitted -> Restricted widget data is not exposed
GET /api/v1/sec/dashboard without authorization -> Receive 401 or authorization failure -> Dashboard data is not returned

features.name: SEC Audit Log
features.description: Allows administrators to search and export the immutable security audit trail without any update or delete capability.
user_flows: POST /api/v1/sec/audit-log/search with eventTypeCode and date range filters -> Receive 200 with a paginated list of AuditLogEntryResponse -> Matching immutable rows are returned
GET /api/v1/sec/audit-log/export with the same filters -> Receive 200 text/csv -> Exported rows exactly match the filtered audit entries
POST /api/v1/sec/audit-log/search with filters that match no rows -> Receive 200 with an empty page -> No audit data is modified
Attempt to update or delete an audit entry by any route -> No update/delete endpoint exists -> Audit log remains immutable

features.name: SEC Active Sessions
features.description: Lets administrators list non-terminated sessions and force-terminate them when needed.
user_flows: POST /api/v1/sec/sessions/search with paging -> Receive 200 with a page of non-terminated sessions -> Terminated sessions are excluded
DELETE /api/v1/sec/sessions/{id} for an active session -> Receive 200 with SessionTerminationResponse -> terminatedAt and terminatedBy are set
DELETE /api/v1/sec/sessions/{id} for a missing session id -> Receive 404 SEC-404-SESSION -> No termination occurs
DELETE /api/v1/sec/sessions/{id} for a session already terminated -> Receive 409 SEC-409-ALREADY-TERMINATED -> Session state does not change

features.name: CU Configuration
features.description: Supports authenticated create, search, read, update, and deactivate operations for common key/value configuration entries.
user_flows: POST /api/v1/common/configurations with a new key/value payload -> Receive 200 -> Configuration entry is created
POST /api/v1/common/configurations/search with paging and filters -> Receive 200 -> Matching configuration entries are returned
GET /api/v1/common/configurations/{key} for an existing key -> Receive 200 -> Configuration value is returned
PUT /api/v1/common/configurations/{key} with an updated value -> Receive 200 -> Configuration is updated
DELETE /api/v1/common/configurations/{key} -> Receive 200 -> Configuration entry is deactivated
GET /api/v1/common/configurations/{key} for a missing key -> Receive 404 or equivalent not-found response -> No configuration is returned

features.name: FILE Categories
features.description: Provides authenticated management of file categories used by the file module.
user_flows: POST /api/v1/files/categories with valid category data -> Receive 200 -> File category is created
POST /api/v1/files/categories/search with paging and filters -> Receive 200 -> Matching file categories are returned
GET /api/v1/files/categories/{id} for an existing category -> Receive 200 -> Category details are returned
PUT /api/v1/files/categories/{id} with updates -> Receive 200 -> Category is updated
DELETE /api/v1/files/categories/{id} -> Receive 200 -> Category is deactivated
GET /api/v1/files/categories/{id} for a missing id -> Receive 404 or equivalent not-found response -> No category is returned

features.name: FILE Storage
features.description: Supports authenticated file upload and metadata operations, plus a public token-based download endpoint and lookup retrieval.
user_flows: POST /api/v1/files with multipart file and metadata -> Receive 200 -> File metadata and storage record are created
POST /api/v1/files/{id}/access-token for an uploaded file -> Receive 200 with a download access token -> Token can be used on the public download endpoint
GET /api/v1/files/download with a valid access token -> Receive 200 with the file content -> File is downloaded
GET /api/v1/files/{id} for an existing file -> Receive 200 -> File metadata is returned
GET /api/v1/files with authorization -> Receive 200 -> File list is returned
DELETE /api/v1/files/{id} -> Receive 200 -> File is deleted
GET /api/v1/files/lookups/{lookupKey} -> Receive 200 -> Lookup list is returned
GET /api/v1/files/download with an invalid or missing access token -> Receive 401 or authorization failure -> File content is not returned

features.name: NOTIF Dispatch and Templates
features.description: Provides authenticated notification dispatching, channel management, template management, notification logs, and lookup retrieval.
user_flows: POST /api/v1/notifications/dispatch with a valid notification payload -> Receive 200 -> Notification is dispatched
POST /api/v1/notifications/channels with channel data -> Receive 200 -> Notification channel is created
POST /api/v1/notifications/channels/search with paging -> Receive 200 -> Matching channels are returned
GET /api/v1/notifications/channels/{id} for an existing channel -> Receive 200 -> Channel details are returned
PUT /api/v1/notifications/channels/{id} with updates -> Receive 200 -> Channel is updated
DELETE /api/v1/notifications/channels/{id} -> Receive 200 -> Channel is deactivated
POST /api/v1/notifications/logs/search with filters -> Receive 200 -> Matching notification logs are returned
GET /api/v1/notifications/logs/{id} for an existing log -> Receive 200 -> Log details are returned
POST /api/v1/notifications/templates with template data -> Receive 200 -> Template is created
POST /api/v1/notifications/templates/search with paging -> Receive 200 -> Matching templates are returned
GET /api/v1/notifications/templates/{id} for an existing template -> Receive 200 -> Template details are returned
PUT /api/v1/notifications/templates/{id} with updates -> Receive 200 -> Template is updated
DELETE /api/v1/notifications/templates/{id} -> Receive 200 -> Template is deactivated
GET /api/v1/notifications/lookups/{lookupKey} -> Receive 200 -> Lookup list is returned
POST /api/v1/notifications/dispatch with an invalid payload or missing required data -> Receive 400 or validation failure -> No notification is sent

tech_stack: Spring Security (stateless JWT — no HTTP Basic)

features.name: SEC Authentication
features.description: Login, self-service sign-up submission, and password-reset request/complete. The only public (pre-authentication) SEC endpoints — every other SEC endpoint requires Authorization Bearer <accessToken>. To authenticate for protected endpoints, POST {username, password} to /api/v1/sec/auth/login and read data.accessToken.

endpoints.description: Login with username/password, returns JWT access token
Submit a sign-up request (does not create a User; creates a PENDING SignupRequest)

endpoints.description: Complete a password reset using a token

response_schema.409: SEC-409-RESET-TOKEN-INVALID — token expired or already used

response_schema.409: SEC-409-SOD-CONFLICT — user would hold two conflicting actions

endpoints.description: Deactivate a user (statusCode=DISABLED) and terminate its active sessions
Reactivate a disabled user (statusCode=ACTIVE)

features.description: Grant/revoke module, screen, and action permissions on a role. Enforces cascading rule hierarchy (module -> screen -> action -> VIEW-before-other-actions) and cascade-revoke.

endpoints.description: Grant a module to a role

known_limitations.issue: TC-SEC-034/TC-SEC-035 exercise an in-process cross-module Spring interface (com.erp.sec.crossmodule.SecUserDirectoryApi), not an HTTP endpoint — not reachable via black-box API testing.
known_limitations.impact: These two governed test cases cannot be exercised by an HTTP-based test tool; they require an in-JVM caller.

known_limitations.issue: REQ-SEC-020 separation-of-duties conflicting-action pairs are declared empty in SEC v1 (deferred — see governance/modules/SEC/execution-state.json api_doc_gaps)
known_limitations.impact: SEC-409-SOD-CONFLICT (TC-SEC-020) cannot be triggered through SEC alone without a FIN-owned conflicting pair seeded; use the FIN entry-creator / period-close-approver pair if FIN is seeded, otherwise this scenario cannot be exercised end-to-end in SEC-only test data.
